visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hands hold a metal bowl filled with fresh green Gai Lan (Chinese broccoli). The setting is a brightly lit kitchen with a red pot and cooking utensils in the background. (2) The hands pick old leaves from the stalks on a wooden cutting board. (3) A peeler is used to strip the outer skin from the thick Gai Lan stalks, with green shavings accumulating on the board. (4) The prepared vegetables are shown in a bowl. (5) A hand adds salt into a white pot of boiling water on an induction stove. (6) The vegetables are added to the boiling water and stirred with a wooden spoon. (7) The blanched greens are poured into a strainer, with visible steam rising. (8) The greens are returned to the pot, and olive oil is poured over them from a pink bottle. (9) More salt is added, and the greens are stirred rapidly. (10) Black pepper is ground over the greens. (11) Chopsticks place a portion of the shiny, cooked greens onto a white plate. (12) A close-up shows the glossy, green texture of the finished dish. (13) A woman in a white apron and striped shirt uses chopsticks to eat a piece of the vegetable, smiling and nodding with satisfaction against a background of wooden blinds.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 超簡單、超好吃的 低溫炒青菜 『清炒芥蘭菜花』. (2) [Slogan]: 蔬菜清洗乾淨. (3) [Slogan]: 先將芥蘭菜花旁的 老葉摘下來. (4) [Slogan]: 老葉的部分、放一堆... 花芽的部分放一堆. (5) [Slogan]: 梗的部分， 用刨皮刀削掉外皮. (6) [Slogan]: 像這樣處理起來 蔬菜吃起來會更嫩口 小朋友會更願意吃. (7) [Slogan]: 當然，不削也是可以的！. (8) [Slogan]: 這邊大概有300克左右. (9) [Slogan]: 煮一鍋水 水裡加入一點鹽. (10) [Slogan]: 水滾之後 先把芥蘭菜花芽放進來. (11) [Slogan]: 再放入葉子的部分. (12) [Slogan]: 芥蘭菜花大約川燙 12~15秒 其他蔬菜 時間約5~10秒. (13) [Slogan]: 快速的把水倒掉. (14) [Slogan]: 瀝乾水分. (15) [Slogan]: 將蔬菜倒回到鍋子裡. (16) [Slogan]: 快速的加入較多的橄欖油 保護蔬菜的翠綠！. (17) [Slogan]: 一小撮鹽調味. (18) [Slogan]: 快速的拌勻 讓油脂包覆蔬菜. (19) [Slogan]: 像這樣 可以保留更多橄欖油的營養 減少油煙！. (20) [Slogan]: 炒出來的蔬菜有水分 吃起來非常的清爽好吃！. (21) [Slogan]: 最後起鍋前 灑上胡椒調味即可！. (22) [Slogan]: 像這樣~ 超簡單、超健康、超好吃的. (23) [Slogan]: 『清炒芥蘭菜花』 就完成啦~. (24) [Slogan]: 看起來油油亮亮，綠綠的 好吃. (25) [Slogan]: 喜歡吃辣的朋友 加一點辣椒調味. (26) [Slogan]: 每天都來一盤. (27) [Slogan]: 這樣炒的芥蘭菜 不僅可以減少苦味 吃起來更順口喔. (28) [Slogan]: 其他蔬菜 也可以比照辦理. (29) [Slogan]: 好嚕！好清爽. (30) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 Youtube:@RosalinaKitchen.
